scene.room_description: What's deader than dead storage? Most of the contents have collapsed or rusted back to the primordial ooze.

blocks.text: You look more closely at the manhole. It's a steel ring set in the floor, with a heavy cover seated inside it.
You try to lift the manhole cover with your bare hands, but you can't get a good grip on it. It's heavy and seated in a steel ring — impossible to just drag it away.
There must be some way to get leverage on this thing. The crowbar might work.
You lever the manhole cover aside with the crowbar, and crusted dirt falls into a dark hole below.
Below the manhole, crude brick handholds provide a slippery path down into darkness. Cool air rises out of the hole.
A chill draft rises from the opening, carrying the smell of damp earth and something older.
